integrity: Proof is an explicit all-parameter integral equivariant chain argument; finite independent checks corroborate but do not establish infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The non-equivariant homotopy type, Betti rank, and integral torsion-freeness are already known from Barmak's work; novelty claimed only for the natural full integral symmetric-group module, explicit equivariant attaching map, and character. Possible earlier equivalent equivariant presentations outside inspected literature remain a priority risk. No claim for Kneser graphs of higher subset size.
title: The integral symmetric-group homology module of two-subset Kneser independence complexes
